an5.240:3.1: āvāsiko piyo → abhāvanīyo piyasobhanā (bj) | piyo → appiyasobhanā (sya-all) | ca → āvāsiko appiya sobhanāca (bj: sīmu)
an5.240:3.4: vuttā → yathābhataṁ cāpi avaṇṇagedhā, catukkamacchera pañcamena cāpi (bj: sīmu); āvāsiko piyo ca sobhamānā (bj: machasaṁ) | cāti → yathābhataṁ cāpi avaṇṇagedhā, catukkamacchera pañcamena cāti (cck: sī. syā.); yathābhataṁ avaṇṇañca, catuko macchariyena cāti (cck: ka.)
